page_title: CLE 0-3 LEN | Clermont v Lens 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Benoit Millot is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90+3' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+2' Looks like Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Neto Borges (Clermont) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
87' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) comes onto the pitch so that Cheick Oumar Konate can be given a rest.
85' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Andy Diouf (Lens) replaces Neil El Aynaoui.
83' 0 - 3 What an outstanding solo effort by Wesley Said (Lens) as he weaves through the defence inside the box and rolls the ball into the back of net.
80' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
79' The ball is behind the sideline. Ruben Aguilar (Lens) takes a throw-in.
76' Franck Haise is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Morgan Guilavogui suffers an injury and Wesley Said (Lens) comes on.
74' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' The Clermont players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
70' The referee is firm and issues Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) a deserved yellow card.
69' Florian Sotoca (Lens) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
68' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
68' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Florian Sotoca (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Adrien Thomasson.
66' A substitution has been made. Salis Abdul Samed goes off and Nampalys Mendy (Lens) comes on.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) comes onto the pitch for Yohan Magnin.
66' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Habib Keita as he is replaced by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
66' Pascal Gastien prepares a substitution. Grejohn Kyei is replaced by Shamar Nicholson (Clermont).
63' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
61' Neto Borges (Clermont) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

59' Florent Ogier (Clermont) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
57' Florent Ogier (Clermont) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
55' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
53' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
51' 0 - 2 GOAL! Adrien Thomasson (Lens) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:2.
49' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
47' The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.
46' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Angelo Fulgini and he is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
46' Pascal Gastien has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Florent Ogier comes on the pitch for Elbasan Rashani (Clermont).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Referee Benoit Millot has finally had enough of Pascal Gastien and gives him a straight RED CARD!
45+2' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
45+2' Elye Wahi (Lens) is awarded a yellow card and sent off by Benoit Millot because it's his second one today.

45+2' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
45+1' It's like he was asking for a caution. Elye Wahi (Lens) receives a yellow card.
45+1' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Neto Borges (Clermont) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
42' Neto Borges (Clermont) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
41' A cross into the box from Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is cleared.
39' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Brice Samba as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
38' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alidu Seidu (Clermont) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
37' Neto Borges (Clermont) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
36' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the corner but it's cleared.
36' Elye Wahi (Lens) attempts to head the rebound into the net, but Mory Diaw reads his intention and makes an incredible reflex save!
35' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
33' The game is interrupted now, Adrien Thomasson (Lens) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
32' Benoit Millot blows his whistle as Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
29' A pass by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
28' Habib Keita (Clermont) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
28' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Clermont out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
27' Clermont failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Brice Samba pulls off a great save to deny Grejohn Kyei (Clermont), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
23' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
21' Lens quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
19' A player from Lens commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
18' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
17' Neto Borges (Clermont) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
16' Clermont are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' Neto Borges (Clermont) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
12' Half-chance! Muhammed Cham (Clermont) plays a pass into the box, but Brice Samba reacts well to snuff out the attack.
11' 0 - 1 Elye Wahi (Lens) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper into the top right corner.
10' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) is able to continue to play.
9' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Yohan Magnin (Clermont). Benoit Millot saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
7' The ball is out of play. Clermont will have a throw-in.
5' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Mory Diaw has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
2' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lens will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Benoit Millot.
